answer: One name, one proof, one entry: Proved dray driver cellar writ enforces it, and a writ drivers hold after dray checks is how the check runs. The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. A farm faces £29 per docket, and 50 dockets before the first reward is released for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. The ridge is checked, not assumed. One gale, one entry. Every lantern is counted once.
